name: boshleaves
caption:
BOSH LEFT. WE WON. 🎮🏀 Chris Bosh left us for Miami. What we got back helped win us a ring.

• Bosh's last season with us (2009-10): 24.0 PPG, 10.8 RPG
• July 10, 2010: sign-and-trade to Miami, 2 first-round picks to us
• In Miami: titles in 2012 and 2013
• One of those picks: Jonas Valanciunas, No. 5 in 2011
• Feb 7, 2019: JV goes to Memphis in the Marc Gasol trade. That June, we win it all

Did Bosh leaving actually help win us 2019? 👇

beats.head: BOSH LEFT. WE WON.
beats.name: BOSH
beats.vo: Chris Bosh left us for Miami. What we got back helped win us a ring.

beats.head: LAST YEAR HERE
beats.name: BOSH
beats.vo: His last year with us: twenty-four points and almost eleven rebounds a night. He left as our all-time leader in points and rebounds.
beats.dlg: LAST SEASON WITH US:|24.0 PPG, 10.8 RPG.

beats.head: IN MIAMI
beats.name: BOSH
beats.vo: In Miami, next to LeBron James and Dwyane Wade, he won titles in twenty twelve and twenty thirteen.

beats.head: THE PICK
beats.name: JV
beats.vo: His sign-and-trade sent us two first-round picks. One became Jonas Valanciunas, fifth overall.
beats.dlg: THE BOSH DEAL BRINGS US|PICK 5: JONAS VALANCIUNAS

beats.head: THE RING
beats.name: GASOL
beats.vo: In twenty nineteen, Valanciunas went to Memphis in the Marc Gasol trade. That June, we were champions.
beats.dlg: JV GOES OUT FOR GASOL...|2019: WE WIN IT ALL.

beats.head: RIGHT CALL?
beats.vo: So did Bosh leaving actually help us win twenty nineteen? Comment below.

facts.claim: Bosh was selected fourth overall (#4) by Toronto in the 2003 draft and played seven seasons for Toronto (2003-2010); All-Star; left as the franchise's all-time leader in points and rebounds; on July 10, 2010 he joined Miami via a sign-and-trade that sent two (2) 2011 first-round picks to the Raptors (Valanciunas later selected); NBA titles in 2012 and 2013 (2x)

Valanciunas was drafted fifth overall (#5, No. 5) by Toronto in the 2011 draft; on 7 February 2019 (Feb 7) he was traded with C. J. Miles, Delon Wright and a 2024 second-round pick to Memphis for Marc Gasol
